notes.title: 0.4.2.0 - Update
0.4.1.0 - Update
Murder Next Room 1st DLC
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce our first DLC!

[h2][b]DATE NEXT ROOM[/b][/h2]
[h3]The only dating sim where you might end up dead or in jail![/h3]

We asked ourselves: what do players truly want? Deep storytelling? Immersive gameplay? No. They want to be trapped in a manor, completing chores for the chance to date someone who might stab them. So we made that dream a reality.

We spared no expense bringing [b]DATE NEXT ROOM[/b] to life. The entire budget went into motion-capturing real-life dating scenarios, including simulated arguments over ‘what to eat’ and intense staring contests with zero dialogue.

[b]Date Next room[/b] will bring a new single player game mode where you are locked inside a manor with 10 hot chicks and one of these 10 beautiful, totally normal women is a [b]MURDERER[/b]. But hey, love is all about taking risks, right?"

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b]Charisma[/b]
These hot chicks are looking for someone who can get things done! 
Build up your Charisma by completing chores in the manor. In this game mode there less talking and more doing!

[b]Chore-Based Romance™[/b]
Love isn’t just about looks—it’s about hard work! Impress your dream girl by scrubbing floors, fixing pipes, and dusting antique furniture. Nothing says “date material” like a well-mopped hallway.

[b]Dynamic Escape System[/b]
If you fail to woo the right person, you’ll need to navigate the manor’s many hiding spots, or just accept your fate.

[b]Romance or Ruin[/b]
The police are just outside the manor! Fail to charm at least five chicks, and you’ll be arrested and charged with [b]first-degree rizzlessness![/b]

[b]Dynamic Betrayal System™[/b]
Love hurts… literally. One of the girls is out to kill you, but she won’t do it right away. Build trust, go on dates, and then BAM—betrayal when you least expect it! Who knew love could be this fatal?

[b]Stealth Dating Mode™[/b]
Romancing someone who’s actively trying to murder you is tough, so we’ve added a stealth system! Hide under beds, inside closets, or behind suspiciously large potted plants while whispering sweet nothings.

[b]10 Unique Love Interests[/b]
[list]
[*] The Rich Heiress – She loves money. Hope you have some.
[*] The Goth Loner – She won’t talk to you until you prove you’ve "seen things."
[*] The Mysterious Butler – Wait, why is there a dude? Who let him in??
[*] The Yandere – Let’s be honest, you already know who the killer is.
[*] The AI-Generated Influencer – Falls in love with you but asks for donations.
[*] The Amnesiac Detective – She was sent to solve a case. Was it… you?
[*] The Catgirl, Probably? – Nobody knows why she’s here. She just is.
[*] The Fitness Maniac – Romance her by lifting heavier and heavier objects.
[*] The Actual Ghost – Are you dating her… or is she possessing you?
[*] The Final Boss – Win her heart or face a quick-time event battle to the death.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.4.0.0 - "Blame It on the Rain" Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm happy to announce the third major update of the game. This update brings the new weather system, improved tasks and map and fixes.

[h2]New Weather System[/h2]
The new weather system brings realistic clouds, rain, wind and lightnings to the game. Players should expect to be dangerous to stay outside in a thunderstorm. If a lightning strike falls near the map the outer fusebox may trip and turn lights off, but If the lights went off, I'll blame it on the rain.

[h2]Improved tasks[/h2]
Instead of randonly spawning on the map, now tasks will have a clear location on the TaskBoard, e.g., Clean Webcobs in Bedroom 9. As I add more tasks I'll reduce the time to complete tasks leaving more time for players to navigate through the map.

Full changelog and plans for future updates at our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wjVkz2BJEJ]Discord[/url].

notes.title: 0.3.0.0 - "No matter what, keep working" Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm happy to announce the second major update of the game. This update brings the new chores system for the witnesses to get busy while waiting for the police to arrive and a scoring system to distinguish those who are working hard from those who are lazy.

Someone's trying to kill you isn't an excuse to not do your chores!

[h3]Halloween event[/h3]
The halloween event brings the first 2 chores added to the game. Witnesses will need to look for Jack-o'-lanterns and webcobs around the map and power them with their blood.

[b]Cursed Jack-o'-lanterns[/b]: Will spawn at random places inside the manor, [b]20 [/b] per player. Giving [b]25[/b] score.

[b]Cursed Webcobs[/b]: Will spawn at random places inside the manor, [b]20 [/b] per player. Giving [b]10[/b] score.

[b]Cursed Tiny Smiley Face Jack-o'-lanterns[/b]: Will spawn at much harder places all around the map, [b]1[/b] per player. Giving [b]200[/b] score.

All chores will cost [b]10[/b] health from witnesses and [b]1[/b] from the killer, but only witnesses earn score from completing it.

Full changelog and plans for future updates at our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wjVkz2BJEJ]Discord[/url].

Happy huntin'!

Thanks,
Havenking.

notes.title: 0.2.0.0 - Right tool for the job Update
notes.notes:
Hi, I'm happy to announce the first major update of the game. This update brings new ways for the players to interact with the map and much needed balances and fixes.

[h3]Reworked Sabotage subsystem[/h3]
Resources like Power, Telephone and Water now have a 2 stage sabotage. In addition to being able to turn on/off the resource, players now can use tools to sabotage/fix it.

[h3]New and improved tools[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Pliers[/b] added to the game. Pliers can be used to sabotage/fix TelephoneBoxes.
[*] [b]Screwdriver[/b] added to the game. Screwdrivers can be used to sabotage/fix FuseBoxes.
[*] [b]PipeWrench[/b] can now be used to sabotage/fix WaterSwitchValves.
[*] [b]Crowbars[/b] can now be used to speed DoorBursting action.
[/list]

[h3]New CollateralAllowed rule[/h3]
After watching streams, videos, and feedback, I've noticed that Witnesses were on average more violent than the Killer. As intended, the game is designed to drive discord among the players with suspicions and a lack of resources, weapons, or tools, but currently there is no scoring system to punish players for bad actions. To balance this, the new rule that hosts can now set is that a witness who killed another witness dies.

[h3]Plans for the next major update[/h3]
With the feedback of the community, I've noticed a common complaint: the lack of side activities to keep the witnesses busy and separated. I decided to move up on the list the planned, yet to be named, Chores update and start working on it. This update will introduce chores for each player, but the killer, and a scoring system. I've not decided the name yet, but it will be something like "Living to work, working to live" or "No matter what, keep working".

I'm also currently working on a new tutorial format to reflect the new changes and improve the learning curve for new players.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked Use/UseHold subsystem.
[*] Reworked PickableObjects subsystem.
[*] Reworked Sabotage subsystem.
[*] Add progressbar to the HUD:
[*] Add Doorbursting animation to the doors.
[*] Add SecondaryActionHold to the Crowbar.
     Crowbars now can speed up DoorBursting action on doors to [b]2s[/b].
[*] Add SecondaryActionHold to the PipeWrench.
     PipeWrenches now can sabotage WaterSwitchValves.
[*] Add Plier tool.
     Pliers can sabotage/fix Telephoneboxes
[*] Add Screwdriver tool.
     Screwdrivers can sabotage/fix Fuseboxes.
[*] Add function to reset player's binding keys if SaveFile doesn't match.
[*] Add new Sabotage to the TelephoneBox.
[*] Add new Sabotage to the FuseBox.
[*] Add new Sabotage to the WaterSwitchValve.
[*] Add InvisibleWall to Salazar Manor to prevent players from jumping off the map.
[*] Add new CollateralAllowed rule.
     Now hosts can check/uncheck if a witness that killed other witness must die.
[/list]

[h3]Balances[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added UseHold action to the baguette stack so players can eat without needing to free an inventory slot.
[*] increases Doorbursting action hold time from [b]5s[/b] to [b]10s[/b].
[*] Added new PickableObjects spawnpoints in Salazar Manor.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix Salazar Manor Backbuilding's Outerhall ambient sound from [b]indoor[/b] to [b]outside[/b].
[*] Improved Chracter's life system stability.
[*] Improved Character's sprint action replication.
[*] Improved door's state replication.
[*] Improved HUD's performance and stability.
[*] Fixed Character's model deforming on distance.
[*] Improved ResourceManager's replication and stability.
[*] Fixed bug where non-killer clients could disconect and break the game loop.
[*] Disabled GameMode/Map selectors on MainMenu.
[*] Fixed Screenprompt not reseting on death.
[/list]
